reason: As a frugal practitioner running a two-person practice, committing ₹12,990 upfront makes no sense when Docketra has a ₹0 Free Pilot for two seats that lets me test if the WhatsApp forwarding bridge actually cuts my Saturday GST reconciliation time.
objection: My clients will never use an intake portal—they just dump bills on WhatsApp, and having my team manually forward messages into Docketra might just add another tedious chore to our week.
would_change_my_mind: Proving during the free pilot that the WhatsApp forwarding bridge seamlessly updates checklists and eliminates my two-hour Saturday GST reconciliation without adding manual overhead.
